Method of Attack: Phishing, File Manipulation, Screen Monitoring, Screen Capture, Keylogging, Browser Information Stealing, Anti-Analysis, Persistence
Attack Vector: The PDF image shows a blurred table and asks the victim to click the malicious link on the PDF file to see the content. Once the link is clicked, a downloader is downloaded. The downloader drops a copy of itself along with a clean installer to the temp folder. It then downloads a DLL, which is executed via DLL-hijacking to run require.exe to download the main module.
